NoSQLServer v0.59 validation
============================

Focus
-----
Grok Hell Corpus v2 Q20: correlated scalar subquery inside JOIN ON.

Root cause
----------
executeInnerJoinChainSelect used a raw `pos(" WHERE ")` search on the complete
JOIN text. A WHERE inside the scalar subquery in the ON clause was therefore
misidentified as the outer WHERE clause, truncating the JOIN before parsing.

Repair
------
- Inner join-chain WHERE detection now uses the existing nesting-aware
  findTopLevelKeyword(..., " WHERE ").
- JOIN connector discovery is separated from full ON predicate evaluation when
  the ON clause contains a scalar subquery.
- The equality connector is extracted from top-level AND clauses which do not
  contain the subquery.
- Candidate joined rows then bind/evaluate the complete ON predicate, including
  the correlated scalar subquery, through the established scalar-subquery and
  predicate machinery.
- Capability: JOIN_ON_SCALAR_SUBQUERY.

Oracle
------
Q20 is independently oracle-backed. Department 10 projects have budgets
500000 and 25000, average 262500; only Hyperdrive exceeds its department
average. Other departments have one project each and therefore cannot satisfy
budget > AVG(budget). Expected result is exactly four Hyperdrive assignments:
Ada/Sponsor, Alan/Engineer, Grace/Lead, Katherine/Engineer.

Result
------
Grok Hell Corpus v2:
  PASS            16
  UNSUPPORTED      6
  PARSE_ERROR      8
  WRONG_RESULT     0
  EXECUTION_ERROR  0
